info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Securities Position Validation API
info.description: The Securities Position Validation API allows financial institutions to validate securities positions within customer accounts. This service enables users to ensure compliance with investment regulations and risk management protocols by submitting securities position data for validation. Typical consumers include portfolio managers and risk assessment teams, who require real-time validation to support informed investment decisions. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their account management processes and maintain accurate securities records.

post.summary: Validate securities position for a specific resource.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to validate the securities position for the resource identified by RES-100045. It performs necessary checks and confirms the validity of the position ensuring compliance with account management protocols.
